annotations.title: Read a section of South African law

description: Full text of one document section from the GetLawED library — use it to read and quote the exact provision found by legal_library_search (give the doc_id and the section reference it returned). For judgments, returns the judgment text (or the part matching "section", e.g. a paragraph number or phrase), capped at 12 000 characters.

section.description: Section reference as returned (e.g. "Section 34: Structures") or a section number like "34"; optional for judgments

name: legal_get_section
title: Read a section of South African law
